description_en: Retrieves a list of Anti-DDoS Proxy instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的详情列表
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you omit this parameter, the system uses the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of instances to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的备注。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Insurance.

1: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Unlimited.

2: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) CMA.

9: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) Professional Edition
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的防护套餐版本。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2： 表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
The service traffic forwarding status of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance. Valid values:

0: Traffic forwarding is stopped.

1: Traffic is forwarded
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的业务流量转发状态。取值：

0：表示已停止转发业务流量。
1：表示正常转发业务流量
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The start of the expiration time range to query. The operation returns only instances that expire after this time. The value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最早到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireStartTime之后的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the expiration time range to query. The operation returns only instances that expire on or before this time. The value is a Unix timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最晚到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireEndTime之前的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_end_time

parameters.help_en: An array of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance IDs. You can specify up to 200 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。最多可配置200个DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: An array of instance statuses for filtering. You can specify up to two statuses
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的状态列表。最多可配置2个DDoS高防实例状态
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The tag key used for filtering. You can specify up to 200 tags.

A tag is a key-value pair defined by a tag key (Key) and a tag value (Value).

You can use tags to filter instances.

The Key and Value parameters for a tag must be specified as a pair
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签键。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签键。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value used for filtering. You can specify up to 200 tags.

A tag is a key-value pair defined by a tag key (Key) and a tag value (Value).

You can use tags to filter instances.

The Key and Value parameters for a tag must be specified as a pair
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签值。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签值。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: An array of tags for filtering instances
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time of the instance, provided as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 实例的创建时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

DebtStatus.description_en: The overdue payment status of the instance. The value is fixed at 0, which indicates no overdue payment. This is because both Anti-DDoS Pro (Chinese Mainland) and Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) are subscription-based
DebtStatus.description_zh: 实例的欠费状态。取值固定为0，表示不欠费，因为DDoS高防服务目前只支持包年包月的预付费计费方式

Edition.description_en:
The edition of the instance. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Insurance

1: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) Unlimited

2: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) CMA

9: Anti-DDoS Pro (Chinese Mainland) Professional Edition
Edition.description_zh:
实例的防护套餐版本。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2： 表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版

Enabled.description_en:
The service traffic forwarding status of the instance. Valid values:

0: Service traffic forwarding is stopped.

1: Service traffic forwarding is active
Enabled.description_zh:
实例的业务流量转发状态。取值：

0：表示已停止转发业务流量。
1：表示正常转发业务流量

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance, provided as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the instance

IpMode.description_en:
The IP forwarding mode of the instance. Valid values:

fnat: The IP versions of the client and the origin server are the same. For example, requests from IPv4 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers, and requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv6 origin servers.

v6tov4: Requests from IPv6 clients are forwarded to IPv4 origin servers
IpMode.description_zh:
实例的IP转发模式。取值：

fnat：表示源站和客户端的IP版本一致，即IPv4地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站、IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv6地址源站。
v6tov4：表示IPv6地址客户端请求转发到IPv4地址源站

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol version of the instance. Valid values:

Ipv4: IPv4

Ipv6: IPv6
IpVersion.description_zh:
实例的IP协议版本。取值：

Ipv4：表示IPv4协议。
Ipv6：表示IPv6协议

IsFirstOpenBw.description_en:
Specifies whether the 95th percentile burstable clean bandwidth billing method has been previously enabled. Valid values:

0: No

1: Indicates that it has been enabled
IsFirstOpenBw.description_zh:
实例是否开启过95弹性业务带宽计费模式。取值：

0：表示未开启过。
1：表示开启过

IsFirstOpenQps.description_en:
Specifies whether the 95th percentile burstable QPS billing method has been previously enabled. Valid values:

0: No

1: Enabled
IsFirstOpenQps.description_zh:
实例是否开启过95弹性QPS计费模式。取值：

0：表示未开启过。
1：表示开启过

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

1: Normal

2: Expired
Status.description_zh:
实例的状态。取值：

1：表示正常。
2：表示已过期

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates this unique ID for the request. Use it to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances found
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的DDoS高防实例的总数量
